_doc: ⚑ S293 — THE ENDING IS THE TRANSJESUS STREAM (docs/reinterp/ENDING_TRANSJESUS_2026-11-02.md, his 'sure we can try. Make this good and storytelling'). The hall, the ballroom, the categories and their cards, the MC, the judges, the Houses and every lamp are gone; nothing here names them. One sequence, no new controls: Junie's link lands on the glass inside the agent's session → the platform frame tries to file the stream and fails four times → the stream grows to fill the glass and she is inside it (the world behind the glass is the stream's place, the old hall emptied of its boards) → TransJesus dances on the floor, wordless, and the people dance with them → the chat is the community; it sees her: 'hi maya', and the count goes 41 → 42 → her one act, dance or stay → the agent comes back for her and the room refuses it by being there → SESSION TERMINATED, in its own ideology → the update fails outside her, and the stream keeps going (it is still on her monitor when the device stops) → the Close. Register: respite. L, the agent's voice, Lamby and the guide are absent from the stream itself; the system's failures happen only on its own surface (the glass), never on the people. Nothing in it is revealed as fake. ALL TEXT IS CLAUDE'S under the 2026-08-17 norm; his edit wins. Every chat line is invented and is nobody's real words.
_docVoice: ⚑ TRANSJESUS HAS NO VOICE AND NO WORDS, EVER. The only sound is the stream's music (ball_room_bed through the wall while the link waits, ball_room_landing once she is inside — his own generations, instrumental). No line in this file may be synthesized: build-time TTS renders the apparatus and never a person.

room._beat: ⚑ ONE MUSIC, THE STREAM'S. frame._beat: ⚑ THE PLATFORM TRIES TO FILE IT (the ending's step 2). The link opens in the device's own player frame, and the frame does its job one row at a time and fails each: it cannot rank the stream, cannot rate its reach, cannot caption it, cannot find it a category. The picture is already moving inside the frame while it fails. Nothing remarks on any of it.

stream._beat: ⚑ THE CHAT IS THE COMMUNITY (step 4). Short, human, collective, lowercase, 2026. Nobody explains anything, nobody quotes anyone, nobody is a lesson. It runs before it sees her, then it sees her — a platform notice, 'maya joined', and the count goes 41 → 42 — and the welcomes run. Then one line that asks for nothing ('dance if you want. or just stay.') and her one act. Handles are invented. ⚑ The chat is drawn large on the stream's own screen behind the floor (readable in a headset) and mirrored as subtitles in the frame.

system._doc: ⚑ THE SYSTEM COMES BACK FOR HER (step 6), and only on its own surface — the glass. A card: reconnecting, restoring her session, a bar that climbs; the room's count holds and goes up; the card cannot rank or caption what it is looking at; the connection is refused because the room is full. Nobody in the chat answers it — they answer it by being there. Then it ends itself in its own ideology. Never a word against the people; never a glitch on the floor.
